keySentence: The rabbit wanted to become real.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The boy was sick. The rabbit stayed close. He wished to be real. The rabbit wanted to become real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The boy became very sick and stayed in bed for days. The rabbit never left his side through the long nights. The rabbit wanted to become real to truly comfort the boy. The boy held the rabbit and would not let go. Their bond grew deeper during those difficult days. The rabbit wished with all his heart to become alive.
